experiment: OBSERVATION-INTEGRITY-002: foreign-eBPF tracepoint gate on the socket sensors, driven through the real ghost-demo pipeline (agent + CollectorSigner + reconciler)

pre_fix.classification: MISSED (honesty): observer stayed Active. T-P silently fell back to polled Presence with no integrity signal; S-P was safe only by the coverage predicate (WindowNotCovered), not by an observer-reported integrity failure.

post_fix.classification: DETECTED: both gated sensors drive ObserverState::IntegrityUnknown -> reconciler CannotProve(ObserverIntegrityUnknown) -> availability Unavailable{ObserverIntegrityUnknown}. Control (no gate) still VerifiedExecution: no false positive.

interpretation: The shipped fix (12767ea) closed the gate only for the sched process tracepoints. Extending the same synchronous, fail-closed detector to SockStateTracer and SockSendTracer, keying the collector's finding per mechanism (worst-of), and wiring it into the live drain converts silent blindness on the socket sensors into a signed 'I cannot vouch'. Strictly monotone: it can only turn a coverage claim into CannotProve.
